records.question: What is our total payout if every in-reach rep crosses?
records.answer:

This assumes each rep sells exactly enough to reach the step and no extra focus pieces. Any extra focus pieces would add ₹75 each.

|---|---|---|---|---|

| Crossing ₹1,00,000 (step 3) | Kavya, Isha, Kunal, Rahul, Bina | ₹27,650 | ₹40,150 | +₹12,500 |
| Crossing ₹50,000 (step 1) | Vidya, Rohan, Jaya, Sanya, Aarav | ₹0 | ₹13,400 | +₹13,400 |
